nodes.title: SG-8.4.2 context.md Stack names the real stack and drops README-only text
nodes.body:
Context: context.md at the repo root is still the 71-line README-only scan. It says 'hello Worldseed' and has 13 UNKNOWN placeholders, so REQ-530 fails. The code is already real: Phaser ~3.90.0, React 18, Zustand 5, Radix dialog and Vitest in game/frontend, Go 1.22 in backend/. Desired behavior: the Stack section and module table describe that stack, and the contextStack and contextPaths tests pass. Expected result: STACK_TERMS and STALE_TEXT checks are green. Why: AI-DLC agents read context.md first. Devion writes context.md itself, so tickets only fix the check contracts in code and prove them with tests.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the repo-root context.md, when missingTerms runs with STACK_TERMS, then the result is an empty array
- Given the repo-root context.md, when it is scanned, then it has no UNKNOWN token and staleTextHits returns an empty array
- Given the context.md module table, when contextModulePaths runs, then it returns game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/, and every path exists on disk


## Scope
- In scope: STACK_TERMS and STALE_TEXT contract in game/frontend/src/lib/docsCheck.ts
- In scope: contextModulePaths contract in game/frontend/src/lib/contextDoc.ts
- In scope: contextStack and contextPaths unit tests
- Out of scope: backend/ Go code and the contribution/round API
- Out of scope: Gameplay, UI or art changes
- Out of scope: Other SG-8.4 steps (SG-8.4.1, 8.4.3, 8.4.4, 8.4.5)
- Preserve: Phaser pinned at ~3.90.0 and the phaser-pin guard test
- Preserve: Every existing test stays, none deleted or skipped


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0 (no Phaser 4 migration)
- No test is deleted or skipped; tests mock only what is external
- No source file in game/src or game/frontend/src is over 200 lines; game/src never imports from game/frontend
- npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/


## Definition of done
- contextStack and contextPaths tests pass
- Typecheck passes in game/frontend


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · context.md Stack names the real stack and drops README-only text
nodes.body:
Context: docsCheck.ts exports STACK_TERMS and STALE_TEXT, but its JSDoc repeats the same rule on several lines. Desired behavior: the contract is stated once, clearly: six STACK_TERMS, Go checked by /\bGo\b/, no UNKNOWN, and no STALE_TEXT entry. Expected result: contextStack.test.ts is green against the real context.md. Why: the stack text must stay checkable.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the real context.md, when missingTerms(text, STACK_TERMS) runs, then it returns []
- Given the real context.md, when text is matched with /\bGo\b/, then it matches
- Given the real context.md, when staleTextHits runs and /UNKNOWN/ is tested, then the hits are [] and there is no UNKNOWN


## Scope
- In scope: JSDoc on STACK_TERMS and STALE_TEXT in docsCheck.ts
- Out of scope: Changing the STACK_TERMS values
- Out of scope: Module table
- Preserve: Exports STACK_TERMS, STALE_TEXT, missingTerms, staleTextHits, missingPaths, indexedPaths unchanged


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0
- No test deleted or skipped
- Files stay under 200 lines


## Dependencies
- INT-1


## Definition of done
- STACK_TERMS contract is stated once in docsCheck.ts
- contextStack.test.ts passes


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · context.md module table lists only the real game, docs and backend paths
nodes.body:
Context: contextDoc.ts has a stray one-line JSDoc above the real JSDoc of contextModulePaths. Desired behavior: one JSDoc describes the four required rows and that every returned path exists. Expected result: contextPaths.test.ts and contextDoc.test.ts pass against the real context.md. Why: the module table must reference only paths that exist.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the real context.md, when contextModulePaths runs, then the result contains game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/
- Given those paths, when missingPaths checks existsSync from the repo root, then it returns []
- Given a table row with README.md and backend/x, when contextModulePaths runs, then only the game/ and backend/ paths return, in first-seen order


## Scope
- In scope: JSDoc of contextModulePaths in contextDoc.ts
- Out of scope: Changing the regex
- Out of scope: Stack section
- Preserve: contextModulePaths signature and behaviour


## Technical constraints
- backend/ (Go) is out of scope and only listed
- game/src never imports from game/frontend
- Files stay under 200 lines


## Dependencies
- INT-1


## Definition of done
- Single JSDoc on contextModulePaths
- contextPaths.test.ts and contextDoc.test.ts pass


## Clarifying questions
- None
